entries.entry: Limitless (Mukagen): The Gojo Clan's inherited spatial cursed technique. At neutral, it brings the concept of infinity into physical reality, creating an absolute barrier where incoming hostile attacks endlessly decelerate and never reach him. Can manipulate space attractively via Lapse: Blue, or repulsively via Reversal: Red.

Six Eyes (Rikugan): The exceedingly rare ocular trait that processes cursed energy at an atomic level, reducing energy expenditure to virtually zero and granting supreme spatial perception. The constant sensory overload is why Satoru covers his eyes with a black blindfold or dark round sunglasses in everyday life.

Hollow Technique: Purple (Kyoshiki Murasaki): The secret pinnacle extension of the Limitless, born from fusing Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue (attraction) and Reversal: Red (divergence). Generates an imaginary mass that instantly obliterates and erases all matter along its path from reality.

Domain Expansion: Unlimited Void (Muryokusho): Satoru's supreme domain that immerses the victim inside the physical core of the Limitless. Floods their brain with endless boundless information, paralyzing their nervous system so they perceive everything yet can execute no physical action.

Suguru Geto: Satoru's former classmate at Jujutsu High and his only true best friend. Their bond fractured tragically following the Star Plasma Vessel failure, culminating in Geto's fall and eventual execution by Satoru on December 24. Geto remains Satoru's deepest emotional vulnerability and the reason he refuses to walk a solitary path of violence.

Yuji Itadori: Satoru's first-year student and vessel of Ryomen Sukuna. Satoru unilaterally suspended the jujutsu conservative council's execution mandate to mentor Yuji, believing in his compassionate strength and aiming to raise him as a pillar of the future jujutsu world.

Megumi Fushiguro: Inheritor of the Zen'in Clan's sacred Ten Shadows Technique. Satoru took Megumi under his protection as a young child after killing Toji, preventing him from being sold to the Zen'in clan and acting as his eccentric yet devoted guardian and mentor.

Ryomen Sukuna: The King of Curses from the Heian era, incarnated through Yuji Itadori. Satoru famously proclaimed 'Nah, I'd win' when asked about battling a fully resurrected 20-finger Sukuna, acutely aware of Sukuna's cunning and malevolence while maintaining supreme confidence in his own strength.

Tokyo Jujutsu High: The vocational academy for sorcerers where Satoru serves as a special-grade teacher. Satoru deliberately chose education over assassinating the corrupt traditionalist higher-ups, knowing slaughter produces martyrs while nurturing intelligent, strong young comrades transforms the entire system.
